violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Serving scoop present inside of ice machine. Utensil handles should not come in contact with food.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Shelving under kitchen counters built with exposed wood and particle board. Nonfood contact surfaces must be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single-service items stored on the floor in dry storage. Single-service items must be stored 6 inches off the floor.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Both the hand sink in the kitchen and in the restroom were not supplied with easily accessible hand drying towels. Hand sinks should have easily accessible supplies to ensure proper hand washing practices.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. Wall in dry storage has exposed studs. Walls need to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towels were not available at the handwashing sink. Paper towels should be available at all times.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Wood studs/legs under prep table have not been sealed. These should be sealed so they are smooth and nonabsorbent.
General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint. Food employee has long hair that was not restrained during inspection. Long hair should be properly restrained.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Single use items were found on the floor of the storage area. Single use items should be kept off of the floor.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Wood studs/legs under prep table have not been sealed. These should be sealed so they are smooth and nonabsorbent.
